title: ADUSA Distribution Claims Processing
description: Work instructions for processing all deduction types for ADUSA Distribution — The Giant Company, Giant Foods, and Stop & Shop. Covers customer general info, signon job aid, deduction types (Off Invoice, Billback, Scan, TPR, Post Audit, Advantage Billing, and more), contract/POP validation, and client-specific instructions for 30+ clients.

sections.title: Deduction Types Covered
sections.content:
The following deduction types are covered in this SOP:

1. Off Invoice
2. Billback
3. Scan
4. Ad and/or Redemption Program
5. Slotting
6. Demo
7. Charitable
8. Coupon (Non-Trade)
9. Post Audit
10. Service Fee
11. Bottle Deposits – Not Acosta
12. Display
13. Removed
14. Other
15. TPR
16. Retail Merchandising Program / Fairshare
17. Returns
18. Advantage Billing

sections.title: Customer General Information
sections.content:
Customer Type: Indirect – buys through C&S, and can buy direct.

Claims created under AHOLPH. Update the customer signon based on the buyer code identifier on the customer invoice.

Backup documentation and POP are normally indexed under AHOLPH. If unable to find backup documentation, search using:
- AHOLPH — ADUSA The Giant Company (also referred to as Giant Carlisle)
- SSAHNE — ADUSA Stop & Shop
- GIANBW — ADUSA Giant Foods (also referred to as Giant Food Landover)
- AHOLDMST — ADUSA Master
- ADUSNE may be used if an order was shipped to YORK, PA or BETH, PA warehouses

Search for contracts using: AHOLDMST, AHOLPH, SSAHNE, GIANBW

Customer Signon Job Aid: https://acostaonline.sharepoint.com/sites/AS_Reporting/Claims_Reports/Forms/AllItems.aspx?web=1

Does this customer subscribe to Nielsen for price point verification? YES

Is line level detail indexed on the customer's documentation? YES

Division identification via Buyer Code on customer invoice:
- NXXX = ADUSA Stop & Shop → SSAHNE
- NSPI = ADUSA Stop & Shop post audit (internal)
- NCNL = ADUSA Stop & Shop post audit (external)
- GXXX = ADUSA The Giant Company → AHOLPH
- GSPI = ADUSA The Giant Company post audit (internal)
- GSPL = ADUSA The Giant Company post audit (external)
- LXXX = ADUSA Giant Foods → GIANBW
- LSPI = ADUSA Giant Foods post audit (internal)
- LSPL = ADUSA Giant Foods post audit (external)
- LCNL = ADUSA Giant Foods post audit (internal)

GC/SSNE on an invoice means The Giant Company (previously Giant Carlisle).
P-Vendor information can be found in the C&S SOP.

FEES: Invoice numbers ending in F are C&S fees charged for deducting on behalf of Ahold. There is no contract for the C&S service fee. Ahold sends C&S invoices in batches of 10. Fee repayment policy:
- $150.00 – Ahold will not repay
- 5% – Ahold will repay 5% of the total value of the invalid invoice only
- $1000 – Ahold will pro-rate the repay based on the total of all invoices

Private label: identified when the REFERENCE field begins with PRV or PV.

Warehouse/Division mapping for C&S deductions on behalf of Ahold:
- Freetown & Chester → Stop & Shop (SSAHNE)
- Jessup → Giant Food Landover (GIANBW)

If the week being billed falls within dates on two events (dates crossover), escalate to the Sales team.

sections.title: Advantage Program & Warehouse List
sections.content:
AHOLD BILL PAYER PROGRAM (pre-paid program):
The Ahold Bill Payer Agreement (BPA) program is similar to a checking account for clients' trade spending. The client determines the types of billings they want to apply to the BPA and then deposits funds according to their forecasted spend. Once the fund is activated with the first deposit, invoices are systematically applied to the client's BPA.

Bill Payer prepaid claims are created from the customer invoice. For clients on Bill Payer, an agreement is signed between the client and AHOLD.

ADVANTAGE BILLING:
- No contract or POP is required
- No client event number will be available; claims should be sent to the client for internal clearing
- Above instructions apply if no client-specific instruction is available
- PXX refers to the period/timeframe that Ahold is billing for
- Stepped as Trade – Other

ADVANTAGE PROGRAM WAREHOUSE LIST (CCNA Locations):
- Stop & Shop – Manchester & Freetown
- Giant Food – Jessup
- Giant Company – Carlisle

Funding numbers on customer invoice determine the customer sign-on:
- ADUSA Stop & Shop → FND-NP4025
- ADUSA Giant Foods (Giant Landover) → FND-GF4025
- ADUSA The Giant Company (Giant Carlisle) → FND-GM4025

Warehouses on Ahold invoices:
- Freetown & Chester → Stop & Shop (SSAHNE)
- Jessup → Giant Food Landover (GIANBW)
- York/Beth PA → may use ADUSNE
- Carlisle → Giant Company (AHOLPH)

sections.title: Contract & POP Information
sections.content:
CONTRACT INFO:
Acoustic DemandTec contracts for all Ahold Divisions are found by searching under customer sign-on: AHOLDMST.
Two contracts are created for Stop & Shop — one for NE and one for NY. If unsure, link the S&S NE contract to the claim.
When alerting for a missing Acoustic DemandTec/VPF Contract: Add alpha code 'AUSA' IN FRONT of the numeric portion of the Acoustic DemandTec# in the check # field (e.g., 'AUSA123456').
Stock Protection on a contract usually means Floorstock Protection. If a contract has 'Cost Difference' verbiage, Sales must clarify the exact type of offer.
Comments at the bottom of a contract can be useful for claims validation and breakdown.

POP INFO:
To determine all items for POP review, consult the contract first — Ahold lists only one item per rate on invoices for Scans and Lump Sums.

AD:
It is at the discretion of the Category Manager at AHOLD whether an ad runs, even if mentioned on the contract. If no ad is found, POP-IRI data is acceptable for all promotion types except Ad Lump Sum.
Ad dates run Saturday through Thursday.

SPIN REPORTS:
Spin reports are updated weekly and provide volume for one week based on a Saturday week ending date.
Search criteria in ACOSTA Relay:
- Client Sign-on: RPTCLIEN
- Customer Sign-on: AHOLPH
- Doc Type: POP Movement/TPR - 7
- Client Ref #: Week End Date (Saturday) MM/DD/YYYY
- Customer Ref #: RAW – Report Type (e.g., RAW – PERISHABLE)

RAW – NON PERISHABLE: Contains frozen, grocery, and refrigerated items.
RAW – PERISHABLE: Contains meat, deli, and other perishable items.

Both reports should be checked for relevant data if client data is missing. Ahold is moving from C&S to Direct Warehouses.

GCC Spin Process — 5, 7 & 10 Rule (ATB claims only):
- If spins are not available, note the line 'pending performance'
- On day 5 and day 7: if not available, note 'pending performance'
- If spin is not available on day 10: step to CRA
- Priority claims take precedence over the 5/7/10 rule

sections.title: Backup Retrieval Information
sections.content:
Is Acosta responsible for obtaining backup? YES
Is there a customer portal? NO
Does Acosta request backup? YES
Is check remittance required to request backup? NO

Backup and POP are normally indexed under AHOLPH.
If backup cannot be found under AHOLPH, search:
- AHOLPH, ADUSA The Giant Company, Giant Carlisle
- SSAHNE, ADUSA Stop & Shop
- GIANBW, ADUSA Giant Foods, Giant Food Landover
- AHOLDMST, ADUSA Master

For P-Deal or P-Vendor deductions (C&S deducting on behalf of Ahold): refer to the C&S SOP.
For pre-paid account (Bill Payer) documents in AR: these are notifications — close in AR and do not process as deductions.

title: Associated Supermarket Group Claims
description: Procedure for managing claims and backup retrieval for Associated Supermarket Group (ASG) accounts.

sections.title: Purpose
sections.content: Define the end-to-end process for deduction resolution and backup retrieval for Associated Supermarket Group accounts.

sections.title: Scope
sections.content: All Acosta associates managing ASG accounts. Covers all deduction types including pricing discrepancies and freight claims.

sections.title: Definitions
sections.content:
**ASG**: Associated Supermarket Group, an independent grocery cooperative.
**Short Pay**: Payment less than the invoiced amount.
**Portal**: Customer-facing web portal for submitting and tracking claims.

sections.title: Roles & Responsibilities
sections.content:
**Acosta Associate**: Primary point of contact for all ASG deductions.
**Backup Specialist**: Retrieves and validates customer-supplied backup documents.

sections.title: Procedure Steps
sections.content:
1. Monitor ASG account for new deductions daily.
2. Retrieve backup from customer portal if available.
3. Match deduction to promotional event or invoice discrepancy.
4. Process valid claims within 5 business days.
5. Issue dispute letters for invalid claims with supporting evidence.
6. Track all open items in the deduction log.
